text:
Maria (CSM): hey team — kicking off onboarding for Helios Health (Enterprise customer). Quick list: confirm stakeholders, define 30/60/90 success criteria, surface any renewal risks, and align enablement + feedback capture. Renewal date: 2025-08-15. Constraints: must support SSO + PHI export controls. proposing a 6-week ramp but flexible. first working session: Thu 2025-03-27 10am PT — does that work?

Jon (Acct Exec): adding stakeholders — Priya (CTO), Mark (Procurement), and Ravi (Head of ML). renewal is currently YELLOW — need 2 quick wins in first 30 days to keep momentum.

Sam (Solutions Eng): @Maria @Jon I can own integration and infra. need their infra contacts for VPC peering — they asked for private deployment. rough ETA: connector + test ingest in ~2 weeks once we have creds. blocker: their security team wants our SOC2 artifact and network diagram.

Lucy (Enablement): I’ll run two enablement tracks: Admin deep-dive + End-user workflows. propose: Admin session week 2, End-user week 4. I’ll prepare a 5-question survey to capture NPS/qual feedback after each session. can we add a Notion page for shared playbooks?

Maria (CSM): yes Notion page please — capture playbooks, session recordings, open issues. also we should collect baseline metrics: avg latency, error rate on sample corpus, and token cost estimates.

OnboardBot: Created onboarding workspace: https://redwood.workspaces/helios-health-2025 and added Maria, Sam, Lucy, Jon. Meeting invite sent for Thu 2025-03-27 10:00 PT.

Sam (Solutions Eng): will upload network diagram and SOC2 link to the workspace. can someone loop in their infra contact? I got an initial email from infra@helios.health but need a named owner.

Jon (Acct Exec): looping in Mark from procurement now — Mark, can you share the procurement timeline? main risk is their fiscal close on 2025-06-30 which may delay contract finalization.

Maria (CSM): ACTIONS:
- Maria: confirm kickoff agenda + send pre-read by EOD tomorrow
- Sam: upload SOC2 + network diag (ETA 48h)
- Lucy: draft training outlines + feedback survey (ETA 72h)
- Jon: intro to Mark & Priya (today)

Lucy (Enablement): for feedback capture: I’ll use a short Typeform with 5 items, include one open text for friction points. I’ll also run a 15-min async recording for end-users and collect comments in Notion.

Sam (Solutions Eng): small technical note — their dataset includes PHI fields. must confirm data handling: will we enable token-level redaction or route through private deployment only? Need legal sign-off.

Maria (CSM): RISK: procurement + legal reviews could push past renewal if not accelerated. request: Jon please secure exec intro to Priya by EOD Fri so we can fast-track procurement. :warning:

Jon (Acct Exec): on it. intro sent to Priya + Mark. response pending. :eyes:

Maria (CSM): thanks. final ask — everyone please add any pre-existing integration docs or support tickets to the workspace. next sync after Thu call will be Tue 2025-04-01 9am PT unless folks prefer another slot. :thumbsup:

Lucy (Enablement): noted. I’ll add a tentative admin session deck and a short checklist for success criteria (adoption targets + 2 priority features).

Sam (Solutions Eng): thumbs up. tagging follow-ups in the workspace so nothing gets lost.

Maria (CSM): great — appreciate the quick responses. keeping this thread for async updates.

(OnboardBot): Reminder scheduled: upload SOC2 and network diagram within 48h or mark as delayed.
